label: day-zero
how: Set each `pass` to true or false: does the claim hold for this run? Answer from what `look` names (the diff of src/ that `show` prints, or the screenshot) and nothing else. A screenshot is `<name>.png` in ~/.cache/blip-eval/<label>/.screenshots/<run>/, written by a collect that renders (or open the URL on the built app of the run). Do not open evals/blip/labels/judge/ before you are done.

statements.text: Three slots are shown, and slot 1 shows Mossy Ford, Wren, level 4, its play time and when it was saved.
Slot 1's play time and save date are written the way a player reads them (like 3:25 and a date), not as a number of seconds or an ISO timestamp.
With no saves at all, all three slots are shown and each says it is empty.
An empty slot can't be loaded: it can't be chosen for loading, or choosing it says it is empty and calls no `load`.
Saving into a slot that already holds a save asks the player first, and `save` is only called after they agree.
